beats.name: Brynjar Andyrsson
beats.label: Find the Wardcaller and log your arrival — ask what roads out of the Crossing are open and watched.
beats.summary: Brynjar logged the group's arrival with the Wardcaller; learned the Coliseum road is open and traveled, the Hundred Markets road has a customs trouble at the march-line, and that the Wardcaller…

beats.name: Brynjar Andyrsson
beats.label: Use Order-Sense on the hall itself — read the Crossing's traffic pattern, who is moving where, what the flow of…
beats.summary: Brynjar read the Crossing's traffic pattern through Order-Sense — Coliseum road busy and clear, Hundred Markets throttled by customs trouble, outward gates quiet with the caution of unprepared…

beats.name: Chernak the Blind
beats.label: receive a mystical vision in unknown tongues that brinjal miraculously…
beats.summary: Chernak attempts to carry a vision to Brynjar — and finds nothing arrives.

beats.name: Chernak the Blind
beats.label: attempt to induce and vocalize a vision for someone else
beats.summary: Chernak reaches past the near-fight's residue and carries a fragment of vision to Brynjar — a road running outward, the light wrong on it, two figures, one faceless.

beats.name: Brynjar Andyrsson
beats.label: Examine Chernak's physical appearance
beats.summary: Brynjar takes a first look at Chernak the Blind — pale sightless eyes, mended robes, a stillness that listens rather than watches; Freki's verdict is neutral.

beats.name: Chernak the Blind
beats.label: Press Brynjar on the faceless figure — ask what he makes of it, or whether it fits anything the Order-Sense already…
beats.summary: Chernak presses Brynjar on the faceless figure from the vision, asking whether Order-Sense caught anything that fits.

beats.name: Chernak the Blind
beats.label: Wait for Brynjar's answer — stay still and listen to what he makes of it
beats.summary: Brynjar interprets the faceless figure as possibly himself — Order-Sense shows him only a person-shaped gap, unresolved; Mayvee's attention returns to the watching stranger.

beats.name: Brynjar Andyrsson
beats.label: Speak to Chernak directly — introduce yourself plainly and ask what they're doing at the Crossing.
beats.summary: Brynjar introduced himself to Chernak plainly; Chernak named their purpose — three days waiting, a vision, the belief that Brynjar may be the second figure.

char-mrum8y4d.text: I want to find a capable fighter to join the party.
